question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The vintage bag was made of __coarse__ black leather.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Rough.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"coarse"** means something that is rough or harsh in texture. (खुरदुरा)

 
 
• **Example: **The coarse fabric irritated her skin.
 
 
 
• **"Rough"** refers to a surface that is not smooth and has an uneven texture. (असभ्य)
 
 
• **Example: **The rough surface of the old table needed sanding.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Rough.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Secure **(सुरक्षित): Free from danger or threat.

 
 
• **Example:** Make sure the doors are secure before leaving the house.
 
 
 
• **Brief **(संक्षिप्त): Short in duration, extent, or length.
 
 
• **Example: **He gave a brief summary of the project.
 
 
 
• **Honest** (ईमानदार): Free of deceit; truthful and sincere.
 
 
• **Example:** She is known for being honest and trustworthy.
 
 

34:T8aa,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
